create.name: Pat Divilly
create.bio:
Pat Divilly is an Irish breathwork teacher, coach and author from Galway who now lives and works mostly from Bali. He began as a personal trainer, studied nutrition and exercise science to master's level, and built one of Ireland's first large online fitness businesses before leaving that world to speak and run workshops on inner life. A first conscious breathing session at a festival in Costa Rica turned him towards the body, and he went on to study relationship work through the Imago and Gottman approaches, bodywork, breathwork and body-based psychotherapy; he is part way through a three-year Core Energetics training.

His teaching joins gentle connected breathing with shadow work and Reich-inspired ideas about the protective patterns people carry in the body. He founded Journey the Breath, a facilitator training that mixes live online classes with a closing weekend in Galway and has certified more than a hundred facilitators in over twenty countries. He also coaches individuals privately and runs programmes for workplace teams. His books include Shadow Work and Fit Mind, he hosted a long-running podcast, and he shares guided breathing, relaxation and stillness practices freely online.

books.title: Shadow Work: A practical guide to embracing your shadow side, tackling shame and transforming pain into power
books.author: Pat Divilly
books.description: Pat's 2025 book on meeting the parts of ourselves we learned to hide, such as shame, anger and unmet needs. It combines his own story with exercises for noticing old patterns and letting more of yourself be seen.

courses.title: Journey the Breath Facilitator Training (Winter 2026 cohort)
courses.description: A 200-hour certification in conscious connected breathwork, run over six months of fortnightly live online classes with self-paced modules and supervised practice sessions. It closes with three days together in Galway and is followed by six months of group supervision calls.

courses.title: In Your Corner: private coaching
courses.description: Six months of one-to-one work with Pat by application: three video calls a month, two half-day intensives and messaging support in between. The work moves between mind, body, breath and relationships.

courses.title: Programmes for teams
courses.description: Live online sessions for workplace groups of up to twenty, built around the inner critic, naming feelings and honest conversation, with short audio practices between sessions. Organisations can begin with a single workshop or talk.

free_resources.title: Pat Divilly on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A large free library of Pat's guided breathing exercises, body-based relaxations and short stillness and acceptance meditations, to play in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: The armour quiz
free_resources.description: A free thirty-question questionnaire, taking about ten minutes, that sorts your answers into five protective patterns drawn from Reichian character work and explains what each one guards.

free_resources.title: The Pat Divilly Podcast archive
free_resources.description: The back catalogue of Pat's podcast, with several hundred episodes of conversations and solo talks on personal growth, habits and inner life, free to stream.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 11.3k (profile via WebFetch, 1 Nov 2026); Instagram 92k (@patdivilly og:description, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube 1.34k (@patdivillyofficial header row, 1 Nov 2026); X and Facebook not readable without login → ~104.6k total → luminary
flags: Tier borderline: ~104.6k total puts him just over the luminary line, and most of it is Instagram (92k), much of it likely built during his earlier fitness career; X and Facebook could not be read.
The email is a support inbox (support@patdivilly.com) in the site footer.
Availability set to worldwide: he says he is from the west of Ireland but has lived in Bali for two years and works online; the only fixed in-person element is the training's Galway weekend.
Kept the book Shadow Work although its subtitle says 'transforming pain into power' (emotional, not medical, pain); a reviewer may want to check.

Site sells breathwork and coaching on mental, emotional and relational wellbeing, not on named conditions; his About page mentions his own anxiety and ADHD, and the training has a trauma-informed practice module. I judged this within the health rule, but it is near the line.
Only the 28 newest of his 141 YouTube videos could be read from the channel page; videos were picked from those.
left_out: Books Fit Mind (ISBN-10 071719132X) and Upgrade Your Life (0857087266, also B07FJXL9TJ): amazon.com /dp/ pages returned 500 to curl and WebFetch, so not verified; Naked Paleo and 21 Day Jump Start are out of print (and fitness/diet).

Videos 'You're Not Depressed You're Frozen', 'The Truth About Why Anxiety Keeps Returning', 'Feeling Anxious About Change?', 'Your Mouth Breathing Is Destroying Your Sleep' and 'Feeling Overwhelmed? Try This 7-Minute Breathing Reset': condition-named or borderline titles.
No Insight Timer courses found on his profile.
Training payment plan (6 × €700) not listed separately.
